translation: Manual English translation of exactly the German extracted musical facts; not the independently written festival English descriptions. No artist names or additional knowledge.

profiles.287: Persian and Kurdish musical traditions with Italian Baroque and jazz influences. Flowing sound.
profiles.226: Irish folk, early music and medieval music; Western and Northern European music for balfolk.
profiles.187: Tarantella and sea shanties. Modern folk band. Vocal harmonies, multilingual lyrics. Acoustic instruments. Old songs and new original pieces.
profiles.252: Balfolk dance music; a modern sound drawing on Sweden, Scotland, Germany and France. Balfolk dances.
profiles.283: Worldbeat, jazz, rock and pop. Guitar, handpans, tongue drums, kalimba and foot percussion. Earthy, danceable grooves. Memorable melodies.
profiles.255: Irish folk, traditional Irish songs, drinking songs and ballads.
profiles.295: Music from the island of South Uist in the Outer Hebrides. Songs in Gaelic and English. Songs alternate with energetic instrumental pieces.
profiles.276: Rhythm and blues and indie pop. Soulful voice.
profiles.190: Traditional Turkish songs with psychedelic songwriting, soul and pop. Baglama as the central instrument.
profiles.184: Chanson pop, indie and jazz. Gentle strings, drums and guitar. German lyrics. Warm, elegant sound.
profiles.218: Songwriting with pop and jazz. Cinematic songwriting.
profiles.230: Songs between chanson, jazz and pop. Two women singing.
profiles.306: Traditional music from Mazovia in Poland: mazurkas, obereks, polkas, kujawiaks, songs and lullabies. Instrumental pieces and dances with swing and great intensity. Songs with the spirit of experimental cabaret.
profiles.316: Regional dance music traditions from Pomerania, Poland and Europe: polkas, kujawiaks, mazurkas and polonaises. Violin, accordion, baraban drum and Kalisz bass. Lively polkas, kujawiaks, mazurkas and polonaises.
profiles.245: Indie folk pop songs with country and Americana influences.
profiles.196: Roots reggae. Very relaxed groove. Falsetto voice contrasting with baritone.
profiles.181: South Indian Carnatic and Western classical music with world music. Violin. Melodic and rhythmic variations. Compositions from the sixth and seventh centuries to contemporary pieces.
profiles.201: Nordic traditions, dance, trance and techno. Diatonic accordion. Mongolian-influenced throat singing. Pulsating, hypnotic sound.
